name: Doodle
traits: loose hand-drawn marker and ballpoint lines
simple shapes: bean bodies, dot eyes, stick-like limbs
playful marks: motion lines, sparkles, little hearts, sweat drops
spontaneous details scribbled around the subject
suits: snacks, apps, stationery, household and everyday products; casual, funny, approachable brands
stylePara: Hand-drawn doodle animation on plain white sketchbook paper: everything is drawn with a black felt-tip marker line of slightly uneven weight, with shapes that do not quite close and corners that overshoot; characters are simple, with bean-shaped bodies, dot eyes and a curved line for a mouth; colour is added by quick marker fills that miss the lines and leave white gaps and streaks; playful marks float around the action (motion lines, sparkles, small hearts, sweat drops, swirls); backgrounds are a few sketchy lines, not a full scene; lots of white paper.

rendering.line: black felt-tip marker, slightly uneven weight, overshooting corners, gaps where shapes do not close
rendering.shading: none, or a few scribbled hatch lines under objects as a shadow
rendering.colour: three or four marker colours scribbled in with streaks and gaps outside the lines; the product filled in its exact green and yellow
rendering.texture: white sketchbook paper, marker streaks, slight bleed where colours overlap
rendering.lighting: none: flat paper; emphasis comes from sparkle marks and motion lines instead of light

motion: Animated on threes with a strong line boil: every line is redrawn each frame and wiggles even on holds; actions are snappy, with a few drawings per move and big held poses; marks pop on in one or two frames; colour fills jitter slightly inside their lines.
camera: Flat and front-on like a page; quick zooms into a detail, a slide to the next doodle; transitions where a new drawing scribbles itself over the old one; no perspective camera moves.
avoid: clean vector lines and perfect circles
smooth tweened motion with no line boil
handwritten words, labels and speech bubbles
sheets: A doodle sheet of the woman (front, three-quarter, side and three expressions) with her bun, orange top and bean-body proportions fixed and a colour swatch for each marker; the fern and the product drawn in the same marker style, the product in its exact colours.
risk: Seedance smooths the line boil away after a second or two (the drawing turns into a clean vector puppet) and loves to add handwritten words and speech bubbles; repeat 'redrawn every frame, wiggling line boil, on threes' and 'no letters or speech bubbles'. Simple dot-eye faces vary from shot to shot, so keep one face reference per shot.

example.prompt: Hand-drawn doodle still on white sketchbook paper: a simple bean-bodied woman in her thirties with dot eyes, a scribbled dark bun and an orange top coloured with a streaky marker fill, holds up a small green glass bottle with a yellow cap with sparkle marks around it; a sunny kitchen suggested by a few sketchy black felt-tip lines and a yellow-scribbled sun in the window, a droopy fern on the windowsill with little sweat drops; overshooting lines, lots of white paper. Vertical 9:16. No text.
